Commentary.Commentary: Coming to the bowling by England, they were not as effective as they would have liked. Eoin in the toss spoke about how they want to bowl better compared to the previous T20I, he would be disappointed as the bowlers gave away cheap runs, bowling favourable line and length to the batters. This is something they have to improve in the short time before the series against the Australians. Just like the previous T20I, the onus will fall on the English batters to see this one home. Will Eoin and Co. bat their way to a victory or will the visitors trouble the hosts with their bowling? Join us for the second innings to find out.

And that will be that for the first innings of the last T20I in this series. The batting of Pakistan had new blood and old blood written all over it. The veteran Mohammad Hafeez and the 19-year old batting sensation Haider Ali put up a 100-run partnership before Haider departed, not before smashing a 33-ball 54. You knew he was in the mood as soon as he hit a maximum right on his second ball. Babar Azam could not impact the match as he would have liked as he went out scoring 21 runs. Mohammad Hafeez continued his exploits from the previous T20I as he scored 86 runs off 52 balls helping the visitors score 190 runs for them to defend.

Yes he can! No boundary in the final over. A couple on the last ball and 9 from the over. Very full and around off, Hafeez drills it back to the bowler who gets a hand to it. Jordan from mid off chases it and keeps it down to two. PAKISTAN FINISH WITH 190/4.
Just a run! Shortish and outside off, Imad looks to smack it through the off side but the ball hits the bottom end and goes to deep cover. Only a run again. Can Mahmood finish it well?
A single now! Quality death bowling from Mahmood. He bowls a fuller and slower one outside off, Hafeez can only drive it to the cover fielder and get to the other end.
Only two! This is good bowling from Mahmood. He delivers another perfect fuller one, Hafeez digs it out once again. This goes wide of the long on fielder and they scamper back for the second.
Full and outside off, Imad looks to smash it over mid off but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes to the third man fielder for a run.
WIDE! Mahmood tries to stay away from the firing line by bowling it wide outside off but this one is a little too wide. Imad lets it be. Called wide.
Excellent first ball. It is in the blockhole on middle, Hafeez can only dig it out for a run towards long on.
Two more! Very full on middle, Wasim flicks it towards long on and returns for two more. Excellent running between the wickets. 11 runs and a wicket from the penultimate over of the inning.

Curran spills the chance this time. That was a dolly. Slower fuller ball around off, Imad is early in his shot and ends up hitting it high in the air towards long off. Curran comes forward and settles under the ball but fails to hold on.
Imad Wasim is the next man in.

OUT! Straight to the man at mid off. Perfect line and length from Jordan. A perfect yorker around off, Shadab looks to smack it over mid off but fails to get under it properly and ends up giving a simple chance to Curran. The promotion to Shadab does no good to Pakistan.
Play and a miss! Around off on a fuller length, Shadab moves inside the crease and looks to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses.

DROPPED! But that was an excellent effort from Morgan. Full and outside off, Hafeez drills it towards extra cover. Morgan there flies to his right and gets his hand to the ball but fails to hold on. It sticks but not this time.

SIX! Excellent start to the over for Hafeez and Pakistan. Pure timing! That never looked going for a biggie. Low full toss on middle, Hafeez chips it over the bowlers head and it sails over the fence.
Chris Jordan comes back on. 3-0-18-1, his figures so far.
Two more on the last ball which means they 11 from the over. Full and on the pads one more time, Shadab flicks it uppishly towards wide of the long on fielder for a couple of runs.

FOUR! This changes things! 9 from the over with 1 ball left. Another fuller ball on the pads, this time Shadab picks the gap between fine leg and deep square leg. Couple of bounces and into the fence. This should give Shadab a lot of confidence for the final flourish.
Full and on middle, this one is flicked to deep mid-wicket for an easy run. 5 from the first 4 balls.
A couple now! Full around middle and leg, cramped for room. Hafeez though manages to flick it between deep mid-wicket and long on for a couple of runs.
Very full and on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run. Mahmood followed the batsman there who wanted to make room outside off.
Mahmood begins the over with a fuller ball around off, Hafeez digs it out towards long on. Shadab wants to return for the second but Hafeez says no.
Saqib Mahmood comes back in. 2-0-17-0 are his figures so far.
Curran bowls this one wide outside off, Hafeez plays it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball outside off, Khan mis-times this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker outside off, Hafeez works this towards the third man for a single.
Full toss on middle, Khan plays this on the up behind the bowler's head, the fielder at mid off cuts it off and the batters get a single.
Yorker on middle, Hafeez fends this off towards mid off for a single.
SIX! Hafeez, stop it you! What incredible batting from the veteran! A full toss on middle, Hafeez bangs it over the fence at mid-wicket for six more runs!
FOUR! Nicely played! Short ball outside off, Shadab cuts it over the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Slower bouncer outside off, Khan looks to cut but misses.
Good length ball on middle, Hafeez pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Hammered! Full delivery outside off, Hafeez hammers it over mid off for a boundary.
Good length ball on middle, Khan plays it to long on for a single.
NO BALL AND A BYE! Full toss on the pads, Hafeez looks to flick but misses. The keeper misses and the ball rolls to the leg side. A bye taken. A Free Hit will follow.
Good length ball on middle, Hafeez flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full toss on middle, Hafeez plays it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full delivery outside off, Hafeez looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.

NOT OUT! Poor review from England as it has clearly gone off the bat! Jordan bowls a near-perfect yorker on middle, Khan defends it to short third man. Jordan appeals as he thinks that it has gone off the pads. The umpire is not interested. Morgan takes the review but the replays show that it has gone off the bat. A single taken.
England have taken a review for LBW! It looks like that it has hit the bat. The replays show that it has hit the bat. Poor review.
Shadab Khan is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Excellent delivery! This is why Chris Jordan is rated so highly by his teammates! Perfect yorker and it needed a delivery like that to end the innings of Haider Ali! Brilliant innings comes to an end from him! Jordan bowls a yorker on off, tailing in. Haider looks to hammer it but misses and the ball goes to hit the off stump. Haider Ali walks back.
Full delivery outside off, Hafeez looks to drive but it takes the inner half of the bat and goes to long on. A single taken. 100-run stand comes up.
Full delivery on the pads, Ali flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Chris Jordan comes back on. 2-0-14-0 are his figures so far.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.

FOUR! Another fifty for Mohammad Hafeez! He is in such terrific form from Hafeez! His 13th in T20Is! Brilliant! Floated on middle, Hafeez goes on his knees and then sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Full on the pads, Hafeez looks to sweep but misses.
Floated on the pads, Hafeez reverse sweeps it to the deep cover region and picks up a couple.

SIX! That made a terrific sound of the bat! Brilliant batting from Hafeez! He is continuing his form from the previous game! Loopy ball on middle, Hafeez dances down the track and hammers it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Hafeez looks to swing it away but fails to make any connection. Wide given.
Tossed up on the pads, Hafeez dances down the track and looks to power it over mid-wicket but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Adil Rashid is back on. 2-0-27-0 are his figures so far.
Good ball to end the over! On a full length way outside off, Ali just leaves this one to end the over.
Short length ball wide outside off, Hafeez pulls this hard towards deep mid-wicket for one run.

SIX! Hafeez is getting his groove on here! What a belting shot this was! Short of a good length ball outside off, Hafeez pulls this hard and the ball sails over the long on boundary for six runs. Anchoring the innings here for the visitors!
A full toss around off, Ali plays this towards mid off for a single.
A back of a length delivery outside off, Ali looks to hoick it towards the leg side but doesn't make contact.
Slower one outside off, Hafeez works it towards the third man area for a single.

FOUR! Maiden T20I 50 for Haider Ali! What a moment for the young man and he is just 19 years of age. Brilliant innings and this makes one think that where was he in the first two T20Is? Brilliant performance from Haider! He reaches there by pulling this short ball on middle to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. How much will he end up with?
Short ball down the leg side, Ali looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full delivery on middle, Haider flicks it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple. Moves to 48.
On a length outside off, Hafeez looks to hoick it but it takes the inside edge and it goes to fine leg. A single taken.
BEATEN! Good length ball outside off, Hafeez looks to smash it into orbit but fails to get any bat on it.
Short ball on middle, Ali pulls it to deep square leg and collects a single.
Flatter around off, spinning away from Hafeez, he looks to cut but misses. Good over for Pakistan, 16 runs off it!

SIX! Two in a row from Hafeez! England needs to stop him otherwise he will punish them! Loopy one again around off, Hafeez, once again slog sweeps this one over the deep mid-wicket area and it fetches the visitors six runs. The English players search around for the ball and eventually find it.

SIX! Hafeez, you beauty! He is continuing where he left out in the previous T20I! This one is a floated delivery outside off, Hafeez slog sweeps this towards the deep mid wicket area and it crosses the fence for six runs. Great shot!
Floated around off, Ali smacks this down the ground, Rashid gets his hands to it but can't stop it as the batters will exchange ends.
Loopy around off, Hafeez comes down the pitch a touch and works this towards mid on for a single.

Loopy one around off and middle, Hafeez looks to sweep but misses and it hits him on his thigh, the players appeal but the umpire is not interested and the umpire is right as the ball looked like it was missing off.
WIDE! That is way outside off and the umpire signals for a wide.
Slower ball outside off, Hafeez looks to hammer it down the ground but misses.
Short ball outside off, Hafeez lets it go.
Good length ball on middle, Hafeez pulls it to the deep square leg region for a couple.

50-run stand comes up between the two! A needed one for Pakistan as they were in slight trouble early on but these two have attacked and are taking Pakistan to a good score. Good length ball on off, guided to third man for a single.

FOUR! Haider Ali is lucky here as Billings completely misjudges this one! He comes in too ahead of the boundary but the ball goes over him! Short ball on middle, Ali pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region. Billings comes in but has to adjust as the ball is going over him. He tries to catch with his hand but fails as the ball reaches the fence.
Full delivery outside off, Ali drives but straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter on off, Ali pushes this towards mid-wicket for one run to end the over.
Loopy delivery around off, Hafeez smacks this down towards deep extra cover for a single.

FOUR! An incredible effort by Gregory at the deep point but to no avail as the umpire signals for four! Hafeez does well to cut this loopy on outside off towards wide of deep point, Gregory runs in and tries to stop it but replays show that this one is a four.
Loopy ball around off, Ali plays this towards the point region for a single.
Flatter around leg, Ali works this towards the deep fine leg area for two runs.
Floated outside off, cut across towards deep point for a couple.
Adil Rashid is into the attack.
Good length ball outside off, Ali pushes it to third man for a single. 12 runs from Gregory's first.
WIDE! Short one down the leg side, Ali leaves it alone. Wide signalled.
Good length ball on middle, Hafeez whacks it to the deep mid-wicket region and collects a single.
Short ball on middle, Ali pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Hafeez punches it to deep cover for a single.
Good length ball around off, Ali guides it to third man for a single.
SIX! Welcome into the attack, Gregory! Haider Ali looks like a real talent! Full delivery on middle, Ali powers it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.
Lewis Gregory is coming into the attack.
Short ball around off, Hafeez lets it go to the keeper.
Slower one on middle, Haider works it to short fine leg for a single.
On a length on off, Hafeez guides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Stunning! Hafeez is in good form and this shot should get him going in this match! Short ball on middle, Hafeez pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full delivery down the leg side, Hafeez looks to flick but it goes off the pads and to the keeper. There is an appeal for caught behind but the umpire is not interested.
Full delivery on off, Ali drives it to mid off and calls Hafeez for a single. Good running.
Just short! Good length ball outside off, Hafeez drives it uppishly but it lands in favour of Morgan at cover. Pakistan are 47/2 after the Powerplay!
Good length ball outside off, Hafeez pushes it to cover for a dot.
On a length on middle, Ali pushes it to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Much more controlled shot from Haider Ali! He has started really well and will want to make use of the start! Short ball on the pads, Ali pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.

EDGY FOUR! Very lucky but Pakistan will take the runs! Haider Ali has come in with positive intent! Good length ball outside off, Haider looks to heave it away but it takes the inside edge and it goes past the stumps and into the fine leg fence.
Quick single! Good length ball on middle, Hafeez works it to mid on and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Beautifully flicked from Ali! Full delivery on middle, Haider flicks it over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. Good end to the over for the visitors.
EDGY! Short outside off, Haider looks to pull but it goes off the bottom edge and goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Short ball on middle, Hafeez pulls it to deep square leg for a single. He is off the mark.
Full delivery on middle, Hafeez flicks it to short fine leg.
Mohammad Hafeez is the next man in.

OUT! TIMBER! That is some delivery from Curran! England bowlers have been far better than they were in the second T20I! No fireworks from Azam this time and he has to go cheaply. England will be pleased with the start. Curran bowls a good length ball around off, angling in. Azam looks to drive but it skids on and beats the bat and onto the stumps. That is an excellent sight for a fast bowler. Pakistan have been reduced to 32 for 2 in the 5th over.
Curran starts with a full delivery on middle, Azam pushes it to mid on for a dot.
Tom Curran comes on now.
Fullish ball on the pads, Babar tucks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
LEG BYE! Short ball on middle, Haider looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the body. The ball goes to third man and the batters take a leg bye.
Jordan bowls a good length ball on middle, Azam flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Good running! Good length ball outside off, Azam cuts it to wide of the third man fielder. Before he can collect, the batters pick up a couple.
On a length outside off, Azam looks to cut but it takes the underedge and into the keeper's gloves.
Full delivery on middle, Azam drives it straight back to the bowler.
Chris Jordan comes into the attack.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Three in a row! Clever batting from Azam! He has started really well and the runs are flowing for Pakistan! Good length ball outside off, Azam deftly guides it to the third man fence.
FOUR! Pulled away in disdain! Poor bowling! Mahmood dishes a short one on middle which sits up nicely for Azam. He waits and then pulls it to the deep mid-wicket area for another boundary.
FOUR! Smashed down the ground! First boundary for Azam! Fullish delivery outside off, Azam drills it past the bowler and into the long off fence for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on the pads, Haider flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for another run.
Good length ball outside off, Azam pushes it to third man for another single.
On off, Azam pushes it to deep cover and collects a single.
Tossed up on middle, Haider tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! Haider Ali has announced himself on the big stage! What a shot! Loopy ball on middle, Haider goes on his knees and then slog sweeps it over the long on region for the first maximum of the game.
Azam drives this full delivery to long on for a single.
Haider is off the mark in T20Is! Loopy ball on middle, Haider works it to long on for a single.
Haider Ali makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! What a start from Moeen Ali! A wicket off his first ball! Zaman cannot believe it as he stands there in disbelief but he has to go. Brilliant stuff from the off spinner. Just the start that England needed. Moeen bowls a quicker one on middle, Zaman is late into his defense as the ball misses his bat and hits the stumps. Brilliant delivery!
Moeen Ali will bowl from the other end.
On a length on middle, Azam works it to mid on. Just 2 from the first over.

Just wide of the bowler! Full delivery on middle, Zaman looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and goes to the right of the bowler. Saqib tries to get a hand on it but fails. The batters take a single as the ball rolls to mid off.
EDGY! Good length ball outside off, Zaman looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and it goes towards short fine leg. Lucky.
Azam and Pakistan are underway! Good length ball on middle, Azam flicks it to deep square leg to get off the mark with a single.
On a length on off, Azam blocks it off the back foot towards point.
Mahmood starts with a good length ball on off, Azam pushes it to mid off from the front foot.
We are all set to begin! The England players make their way out to the middle, followed by Fakhar Zaman and Babar Azam. Saqib Mahmood will start with the ball.

The Pakistani skipper, Babar Azam starts off by saying that he would have bowled too, but the toss is out of their hands but they will bat well and post a good score. Adds that there are three changes as Haider Ali, Sarfaraz Ahmed and Wahab Riaz come into the starting XI. Ends by saying that they are confident and want to end the series on a high-note.

The English skipper, Eoin Morgan starts off by saying that the pitch is a fresh one and it is also drier compared to the previous ones. Continues by saying that it will offer something to the bowlers, but more to the batters. Adds that there is no hiding place for a bowler in a T20I clash. Adds that the side will be unchanged. Ends by saying that they hope to be better with the ball in this game.

Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Haider Ali (IN PLACE OF IFTIKHAR AHMED), Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK) (IN PLACE OF MOHAMMAD RIZWAN), Shadab Khan, Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz (IN PLACE OF MOHAMMAD AMIR), Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf.
England (Unchanged playing XI) - Tom Banton, Jonny Bairstow (WK), Dawid Malan, Eoin Morgan (C), Moeen Ali, Sam Billings, Lewis Gregory, Tom Curran, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid, Saqib Mahmood.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of England! They have elected to field.

Hello everyone! It is time for the Pakistan's tour of England to finish and it is set up to be a thrilling finish. England won their last game emphatically and they will look to finish the series with a win and go into the Australia series with confidence. Pakistan, on the other hand, have not won a single game on this tour so far and they would want to finish the series on a high. What changes are they likely going to make? We shall find out soon enough as the toss and team updates is not far away.
